plan: Since my value is $28, which is outside the typical range of 0-20, I should bid aggressively to secure the win. I will bid slightly above the maximum possible value in the standard range to ensure I win, but not too high as to risk overpaying significantly if someone else also has an unusually high value. I will bid $20.50.

My value is $16. I want to win if my value exceeds the second-highest bid. I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win, but not so low that I lose out on potential wins. A reasonable starting bid is around 90% of my value. I will bid $14.40.

I will bid slightly above what I expect the second-highest bid to be. Since the values are between 0 and 20, and there are three bidders, the second-highest value is likely to be around 2/3 of 20, which is around 13.33. I will bid slightly above that, say 13.5. If I win, my profit will be 19 - 13.5 = 5.5. If I lose, I make nothing.
